SELECT  "t0"."code" AS "code",
( ts_rank(ARRAY[0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 1.0],"t0"."description", websearch_to_tsquery(CAST('simple' AS regconfig), :q),8) ) AS "probe",
"t0"."id" AS "pkey"
 FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS t0
WHERE ("t0"."description" @@ websearch_to_tsquery(CAST('simple' AS regconfig),:q)) AND ("t0"."__del_ts" IS NULL)
